integration_summary.note: Every independent result is retained. The auxiliary-scale control is 2.35 quoted errors above the reference and 1.67 combined errors above the independent thermal run; no result is selected away or averaged to hide this scatter.

limitations: Hard timelike K=(4,0,0,1), T=1, one massless quark flavor only; no claim of general soft/collinear safety, light-cone resummation, or thermal IR/threshold subtraction.

The current independent thermal NLO Monte Carlo uncertainty is 3.61percent, larger than the historical million-sample0.94percent result. The run-card0.2percent target was not reached and was not treated as a prerequisite.
Zero final discarded samples in these200000samples does not bound every unseen exceptional configuration. Intermediate nonfinite native attempts were recovered by ordinary precision escalation.
The auxiliary UV-scale control provides statistical compatibility at the quoted precision, not a high-precision scale-invariance certificate.
